'''Grogur''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a guard during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he was one of the guards at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grogur was one of thirteen Gamorreans that could be found in Jabba's palace in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. This contradicted several other canon sources that claim only nine Gamorreans worked in the palace. This was further contradicted by the fact that [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]], [[Thug/Legends|Thug]], [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]], [[Warlug]], [[Ghana Gleemort/Legends|Ghana Gleemort]], and [[Grissom (Gamorrean)|Grissom]] were not in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], suggesting that a total of nineteen Gamorrean guards worked in Jabba's palace.
